messages:
aisha: quick sanity check — rolled the AWQ-4bit quant reranker onto canaries in us-west1 and london, and a parallel canary in ap-south-east. numbers look inconsistent, AP region way slower and p95 spikes.

matt: which nodes? GPU type?

aisha: us-west1 n1-standard w/ A10G, london is A10G as well, ap-south-east is T4 pool. same model/artifact. config: batch=16, dims=1024, seq=128, nvlink disabled for canary.

sergey: T4 perf with AWQ can be weird, kernel fallback often to aten for some ops. can you paste the runner log?

aisha: pasted below — output from rbench v2
```
[us-west1] throughput: 450 qps, p95: 32ms, gpu mem: 7.2GB
[london]   throughput: 410 qps, p95: 36ms, gpu mem: 7.1GB
[ap-south] throughput: 188 qps, p95: 142ms, cpu-fallback: true
logs: kernel_select: fallback->aten_matmul for attn; cuBLAS init ok; cuda driver 535.86
```

jess: dims/batch sweep numbers?

aisha: quick sweep:
```
dims=768 batch=8  -> us-west 620 qps, ap-south 260 qps
dims=1024 batch=16 -> us-west 450 qps, ap-south 188 qps
dims=1536 batch=32 -> us-west 220 qps, ap-south 96 qps
```

matt: looks like ap-south kernel selection + smaller GPU (T4) causing heavy CPU fallback. also check numa/cpuset — T4 nodes are 2-socket with different cpu-to-pci lanes.

sergey: run this on ap-south single-socket pinned: `numactl --cpunodebind=0 --membind=0 ./rbench --model rerank-awq4 --batch 16`

aisha: doing that now, will report.

deploy-bot: canary deploy 7765 started: reranker-awq4 @ ap-south

matt: if single-socket fixes it we should add a node-level sampler to infra to disable cross-socket cpus for GPU pods. also check TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST and CUTLASS fallback logs.

aisha: single-socket run improved to 360 qps, p95 58ms, kernel_select: cutlass_gemm used. so it's numa/cpuset issue + kernel mismatch.

jess: action items: 1) infra add numa pin for GPU pods in ap-south canary; 2) ML add kernel whitelisting or shim to prefer cutlass for T4; 3) product note for capacity sizing — treat T4 region as 0.5x A10G for AWQ4 rerank.

aisha: assigning myself to 2, matt to 1. I'll open evals ticket for quality regression check after we flip kernels.

sergey: also file a telemetry patch to log kernel reason code for all runs.

matt: +1

aisha: thanks, will update thread with PR links.
